02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE RIG

Hi, I’m Martin.
Always curious.

Mart in 3D

Wall-E opened the door to 3D.
Minecraft introduced me to code.

That’s where my fascination with art and technology began. I love learning, exploring new ideas, and discovering how a little scripting can solve a creative problem.

I enjoy building tools, sharing what I learn, and hearing how things could be better. My career goal is to become a Rigging TD—and, along the way, make a positive impact through the things I create.
